scope: Exploratory fixed squads, original members/cost/three item owners/partner fixed; only positions and one TM replacement vary. Side swaps are verification, not independent trials. No tuning or balance acceptance.
limits: Selection was based on the same 20 exploratory seeds; no significance or balance claim.
No squad members, stat budgets, item ownership, partner, engine parameters or opponents positions changed.
Failed and negative-delta arms are retained; independent follow-up seeds are required.
Apparent improvements with 0 guard triggers were removed-old-TM effects, not interception benefits; active-versus-disabled fields separate this confound.
